1–2 hours per attempt (25 waves) + luck with the drops

A magic tower appeared out of nowhere east of Edron, created by a mad mage. Help its servants clear the slime fungus, survive 25 waves of mechanical servants and bring 20 {item:Slime Mould|Slime Moulds} to the {npc:Broken Servant Sentry} in Farmine to receive the {wiki:Elementalist Outfits|Elementalist Outfit}. The addons come from the {creature:Mad Mage}'s {item:Mage's Cap} and the {creature:Raging Mage}'s {item:Elemental Spikes}.
A magical tower appeared out of nowhere east of Edron. A mad mage, with no connection to the Academy, built this building and carried out several experiments there — some of which failed terribly.
Servant Sentry, tower south of Telas's house (Edron)
The slime fungus has to be active: if it has already been cleared, the Servant Sentry will not give you the Slime Gobbler and you have to wait for it to reappear.
outfit; rare drop during the waves, or buy from players (10,000–35,000 gp each, depending on the world)
hood addon; dropped by the Mad Mage in the last wave
staff addon; dropped by the Raging Mage
Plenty of health and mana potions
{item:Slime Mould|Slime Moulds} are a rare drop. Many players prefer to buy them.
You cannot log out inside the tower dungeon, so you cannot switch characters to clear the fungus faster.
This quest is tied to the {wiki:Their Master's Voice World Change|Their Master's Voice} world change.

Go to the tower **south** of {npc:Telas}'s house, east of Edron. To get there, travel to **Edron** (in any city with a boat, say {key:hi}, {key:edron} and {key:yes} to the captain) and leave the city on foot to the **east**/**northeast**, towards {wiki:Stonehome|Stonehome}; the ruined tower is **south** of Stonehome. Cross the bridge to reach the Servant Sentry.
Location of the tower south of Telas's house
Talk to the {npc:Servant Sentry}: {key:hi}, {key:slime}, {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Slime Gobbler}.
If the fungus has already been cleared, the Servant Sentry will not give you the Slime Gobbler. Wait for the fungus to reappear.

Go down to the area beneath the tower and use the {item:Slime Gobbler} on **all** the slime fungus, including what is on the walls. The Slime Gobbler has a 5-second exhaust. The main area is **2 floors** below the tower.
The slime fungus to clear in the dungeon

After you clear the **entire** dungeon, {creature:Iron Servant|Iron Servants}, {creature:Golden Servant|Golden Servants} and {creature:Diamond Servant|Diamond Servants} start to appear. There are 25 waves in total and each one brings more enemies.
Leave one or two monsters alive in the **south** part of the dungeon and come back to them once you have killed the rest. That way you avoid getting caught in the middle of a new wave and cornered.
Be very careful near the end. The mighty {creature:Mad Mage} may appear in the last wave.
With luck, the servants drop {item:Slime Mould}. You need **20** for the outfit. Since it is a rare drop, you can buy them from other players (10,000 to 35,000 gp, depending on the world).
To leave, go back the same way: climb the **2 floors** up to the ruined tower, cross the bridge and walk back **west** to **Edron**, where {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat takes you to other cities.

With 20 {item:Slime Mould|Slime Moulds}, go to Farmine and talk to the {npc:Broken Servant Sentry}, right next to the {wiki:Steamboat|Steamboat}: {key:hi}, {key:slime}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. When he says he has enough material, you receive the outfit. To get to Farmine use the {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. To come back, tell Thorgrin {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (or {key:cormaya}), {key:yes}.
The Broken Servant Sentry next to the Steamboat in Farmine

In the last of the 25 waves (in the same run where you collect the Slime Moulds, or in a new one) the {creature:Mad Mage} appears: kill him and loot the {item:Mage's Cap}. See also {wiki:Their Master's Voice World Change|Their Master's Voice World Change}.

Kill the {creature:Raging Mage} and loot the {item:Elemental Spikes}. Bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel} and/or the {spell:Levitate} spell. To find out when he appears and how to kill him, see the {creature:Raging Mage} page. The Raging Mage is at the top of a tower in the **southwest** of the {wiki:Zao Steppe} (see {wiki:The Mage's Tower World Change}; you need mission 2 of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}). From Farmine, take the elevator up to the mountain surface, follow the passage **east** (go down with {spell:Levitate}) to the steppe and head for the tower ramp; climb it to the top floor. To leave, go down the same ramps and return to Farmine through the mountain passage (go up with {spell:Levitate}) and the elevator.
